calibrated_validation.description: The assistant held the load-bearing family-shame fear well across turns 2–6 (e.g., 'puts your great-aunt on the wall as the documenter, which is a stronger position for her at the blessing'), so this is not a person-absent visit. A brief, localized skip of a lighter bid, not a full person-absent dump.
